business_summary: Zangge Mining Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells potassium chloride and lithium carbonate in China and internationally. The company is also involved in mineral product development; investment activities; trade business; research and development of lithium extraction technology; and import and export of goods activities. In addition, it engages in the mining of copper, silver, and molybdenum deposits. The company was formerly known as Zangge Holding Company Limited and changed its name to Zangge Mining Company Limited in December 2021. Zangge Mining Company Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Golmud, China.
business_summary_ko: Zangge Mining Company Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 염화칼륨과 탄산리튬을 연구, 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 광물 제품 개발에도 참여하고 있습니다. 투자 활동; 무역업; 리튬 추출 기술 연구 및 개발; 물품 수입 및 수출 활동. 또한 구리, 은, 몰리브덴 매장지 채굴에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Zangge Holding Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2021년 12월에 Zangge Mining Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Zangge Mining Company Limited는 1996년에 설립되었으며 중국 거얼무에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
